body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended The updated skill documentation’s Copilot-login list is now inconsistent with the script’s actual matching behavior, which can mislead troubleshooting for the new review-body path. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This PR updates the `resolve-copilot-pr-feedback` plugin so it can detect and act on Copilot findings that are emitted in **PR review bodies** (suppressed-comments sections), not just inline `reviewThreads`, and adds scrut coverage for the new parser entry point. **Changes:** - Add `fetch-reviews` and stdin-driven `parse-reviews` commands to extract suppressed review-body findings (with format-drift signaling). - Update the skill workflow and reporting format to incorporate review-body findings alongside threads (including idempotency via prior summary scan). - Introduce a scrut test suite with real-body fixtures and wire it into CI/Makefile env.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/scrut/resolve-copilot-threads.md | Scrut coverage for `parse-reviews` behavior across known Copilot body layouts and error paths. | | tests/data/copilot-reviews/format-a.json | Fixture for oldest “comments suppressed due to low confidence” layout. | | tests/data/copilot-reviews/format-b.json | Fixture for mid “suppressed comments summary” layout. | | tests/data/copilot-reviews/format-c.json | Fixture for current “review details → suppressed comments” layout (with “Previously missed” subheading). | | tests/data/copilot-reviews/no-suppressed.json | Fixture ensuring normal reviews with `
` blocks don’t false-positive as suppressed. | | tests/data/copilot-reviews/drift.json | Fixture validating “marker present but zero structured findings” drift behavior. | | tests/data/copilot-reviews/non-copilot.json | Fixture ensuring non-Copilot reviews are filtered out. | | plugins/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/skills/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/SKILL.md | Skill workflow updates to require checking both threads and review bodies, plus new summary-table semantics. | | plugins/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/scripts/resolve-copilot-threads | Adds `fetch-reviews`/`parse-reviews`, splits dependency checks, and implements the jq-based body parser. | | plugins/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/README.md | Plugin README updated to describe review-body handling and add comment-read permission guidance. | | plugins/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/.claude-plugin/plugin.json | Bumps plugin version to 1.5.0 for the new capability. | | Makefile | Wires scrut env vars for the new resolver script and fixture directory. | | docs/plans/done/2026-09-09-copilot-review-body-findings.md | Design/implementation record for the feature (done plan). | | dist/codex/plugins/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/skills/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/SKILL.md | Regenerated Codex mirror of the updated skill. | | dist/codex/plugins/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/scripts/resolve-copilot-threads | Regenerated Codex mirror of the updated resolver script. | | dist/codex/plugins/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/README.md | Regenerated Codex mirror README update. | | dist/codex/plugins/resolve-copilot-pr-feedback/.claude-plugin/plugin.json | Regenerated Codex mirror version bump. | | .github/workflows/ci.yml | Adds scrut env vars so CI can run the new scrut document. | | .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | Updates catalog state + plugin version entry. | | .agents/plugins/marketplace.json | Updates generated marketplace mirror to match catalog state + plugin version. |
